en.sayed-ali-raza-rizvi: 10. Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-Shaybani (ra) said: Muhammad ibn Abu `Abd Allah al-Kufi said: Musa ibn `Imran al-Nakha`I said, on the authority of his paternal uncleal-Husayn ibn Yazi al-Nawfali, on the authority of `Ali ibn Salim, on the authority of his father, on the authority of Abu Basir
that I asked Abu Abd Allah Ja`far al-Sadiq (as) about the Word of Allah, the Mighty and High:
And they shall continue to differ, except those on whom your Lord has mercy; and for this did He create them.
He replied, “He created them to do what makes them deserve His Mercy so that He may have mercy on them.”
